lean.statement: theorem phaseWassersteinSq_initial_le_position_moment (π : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure π] (xref : E) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (hpos : Integrable (fun y : E => ‖xref - y‖ ^ 2) π) : PhaseMetric.phaseWassersteinSq κ ((Measure.dirac xref).prod (stdGaussian E)) (π.prod (stdGaussian E)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y : E, ‖xref - y‖ ^ 2 ∂π)
approved_definition_context: E is a finite-dimensional complete real inner-product Borel space; all measures below are on E or E times E.

The phase transport quantity is the Kantorovich infimum for a quadratic cost induced by a two-by-two block form, with position coefficient 1/(2*kappa)+1/2, position-momentum cross term one, and momentum coefficient one.
The standard Gaussian law is a centered probability measure; Measure.prod forms independent product laws.
